title: The Gold Safe-Haven Myth

beats.say: Holding gold for 20 years lost buyers nearly 80% against inflation between 1980 and 2000.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a heavy gold bar resting on dark, wet slate under a single cold blue overhead light.

beats.say: That's decades of purchasing power vanished into a shiny metal brick that sits in a vault.
beats.visual: Low angle of a massive steel vault door half-open, casting a long shadow across a damp concrete floor.

beats.say: So why do millions still treat gold as the ultimate safe-haven wealth builder?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person staring out a tall skyscraper window at a foggy, rain-slick city skyline at dusk.

beats.say: Most people assume unyielding metal protects you best when markets turn brutal and uncertain.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a lone pedestrian walking under a sodium-lit underpass at night, heavy rain falling.

beats.say: But gold is an unproductive asset. It doesn't produce cash flow, dividends, or goods.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a tarnished coin resting on raw, cold steel, shot with a shallow depth of field.

beats.say: While gold sat flat, what happens when you put that same cash into income-producing assets?
beats.visual: High angle shot of a massive container ship cutting through dark, choppy open water at twilight.

beats.say: Investing $500 a month at 8% a year reaches $745,180 in 30 years.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a stark mountain ridge line cutting across a pale winter sky at dawn.

beats.say: You only put in $180,000 of your own hard-earned cash.
beats.visual: Close-up of calloused hands sliding a plain metal box across a dark, scarred wooden table.

beats.say: That is the power of compounding dividends and productive businesses driving real growth.
beats.visual: Low angle of a towering concrete bridge pier stretching up into heavy, low-hanging gray fog.

beats.say: Metals just store value. Businesses grow it.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a heavy industrial gear slowly turning in dim, cold fluorescent light.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person walking away down the center of an empty highway at night under sodium lights.

caption: Gold isn't building your wealth. Here's why productive assets win over decades. #personalfinance #moneytips #investing #wealthbuilding #finance
